outliers.why: THE TALL NORTH LIGHTHOUSE the operator asked for, beside the north dock. MEASURED: drake-lighthouse is the TALLEST body in the lighthouse pool -- 38 walkable levels against 22 for the runner-up -- and its solid collider stack spans 50.083 m, 47.083 m of it above the floor a player enters on. Seated on this pad (target_y 32.98) its lantern gallery, the 196 m2 top walkable surface the beacon stands on, is 40.08 m ABOVE SEA LEVEL and its roof cap 50.06 m. The pad is 19.6 m from the nearest pier piece with the worst natural sample inside the written square AND its 1 m spread ring at 31.043 m -- 1.043 m above c_WaterLevel 30.0 -- and 0 pier pieces inside the written region, so no terrain write goes under the deck or below the water plane. 53 otherwise-legal offsets were REFUSED on a wet spread ring, including the first pick (-178,2596) whose ring corner measured 29.866 m. NO PORTAL: the dock's own `x-north` pair stands 20 m away, and a second arch for the same place is a second convention, not access.
